Psalms 117 · Psalm 117: Praise the Lord, All Ye Nations

points: O praise the Lord, all ye nations; praise Him, all ye people. His merciful kindness is great toward us and the truth of the Lord endures forever.
These are the only two verses in this psalm, a short call to praise Him for His mercy and His enduring truth.
